snippet.title: Dino Citadel - Monster Taming Direct Trailer
snippet.description:
Dino Citadel - Monster Taming Direct 2025 Trailer

Command your castle-on-a-dino in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder!

Command a castle-on-a-dino through a corrupted world. Rescue fallen allies, lead them in battle, and build your deck. Manage your economy to draw cards and confront the Voidrift in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder!

🎮 Add to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352930/Dino_Citadel/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer
